public export
Tensor : Nat -> Nat -> Type
Tensor n m = Vect n (Vect m Double)

public export
Pair : Type -> Type -> Type
Pair a b = (a, b)

public export
sum : Num a => Vect n a -> a
sum [] = 0
sum (x :: xs) = x + sum xs

public export
allFins : (n : Nat) -> Vect n (Fin n)
allFins Z = []
allFins (S k) = FZ :: map FS (allFins k)

public export
transpose : {m, n : Nat} -> Tensor m n -> Tensor n m
transpose {n = Z} _ = replicate Z []
transpose {n = S k} [] = replicate (S k) []
transpose {n = S k} (x :: xs) = zipWith (::) x (transpose xs)

public export
dot : Num a => Vect n a -> Vect n a -> a
dot xs ys = sum (zipWith (*) xs ys)

public export
matMul : {m, n, p : Nat} -> Tensor m n -> Tensor n p -> Tensor m p
matMul a b = map (\row => map (\col => dot row col) (transpose b)) a

public export
scaleTensor : Num a => a -> Tensor n m -> Tensor n m
scaleTensor s = map (map (* s))

public export
addTensor : Num a => Tensor n m -> Tensor n m -> Tensor n m
addTensor = zipWith (zipWith (+))

public export
scaleVect : Num a => a -> Vect n a -> Vect n a
scaleVect s = map (* s)

public export
addVect : Num a => Vect n a -> Vect n a -> Vect n a
addVect = zipWith (+)

public export
mulVect : Num a => Vect n a -> Vect n a -> Vect n a
mulVect = zipWith (*)

public export
divVect : Fractional a => Vect n a -> a -> Vect n a
divVect xs d = map (/ d) xs

public export
maximum : Ord a => Vect (S n) a -> a
maximum (x :: []) = x
maximum (x :: (y :: xs)) = let m = maximum (y :: xs) in if x > m then x else m

public export
softmax : Vect (S n) Double -> Vect (S n) Double
softmax xs = let m = maximum xs
                 ex = map (\x => exp (x - m)) xs
                 s = sum ex
             in map (\x => x / s) ex

public export
silu : Double -> Double
silu x = x / (1.0 + exp (-x))

public export
splitAt : (n : Nat) -> Vect (n + m) a -> (Vect n a, Vect m a)
splitAt Z xs = ([], xs)
splitAt (S k) (x :: xs) = let (ys, zs) = splitAt k xs in (x :: ys, zs)

public export
take : (n : Nat) -> Vect (n + m) a -> Vect n a
take n xs = fst (splitAt n xs)

public export
drop : (n : Nat) -> Vect (n + m) a -> Vect m a
drop n xs = snd (splitAt n xs)

public export
finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat FZ = Z
finToNat (FS k) = S (finToNat k)

public export
record Linear (inFeatures : Nat) (outFeatures : Nat) where
  constructor MkLinear
  weight : Tensor outFeatures inFeatures
  bias : Vect outFeatures Double

public export
forwardLinear : {inF, outF, b : Nat} -> Linear inF outF -> Tensor b inF -> Tensor b outF
forwardLinear (MkLinear w bias) x = let prod = matMul x (transpose w)
                                         biasMat = replicate b bias
                                     in zipWith addVect prod biasMat

public export
record LayerNorm (normalizedShape : Nat) where
  constructor MkLayerNorm
  weight : Vect normalizedShape Double
  bias : Vect normalizedShape Double
  eps : Double

public export
castNatDouble : Nat -> Double
castNatDouble Z = 0.0
castNatDouble (S k) = 1.0 + castNatDouble k

public export
forwardLayerNorm : {d, b : Nat} -> LayerNorm d -> Tensor b d -> Tensor b d
forwardLayerNorm ln x = let dNat = castNatDouble d
                            mean = map (\row => sum row / dNat) x
                            diff = zipWith (\row, m => map (\v => v - m) row) x mean
                            variance = map (\row => sum (map (\v => v * v) row) / dNat) diff
                            invStd = map (\v => 1.0 / sqrt (v + ln.eps)) variance
                            norm = zipWith (\row, s => scaleVect s row) diff invStd
                            scaled = map (mulVect ln.weight) norm
                        in zipWith addVect scaled (replicate b ln.bias)

public export
record Attention (dim : Nat) (numHeads : Nat) (headDim : Nat) where
  constructor MkAttention
  qProj : Linear dim dim
  kProj : Linear dim dim
  vProj : Linear dim dim
  outProj : Linear dim dim
  scale : Double

public export
forwardAttention : {dim, nH, hD, b, seq : Nat} -> Attention dim nH hD -> Tensor b seq dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq 1) -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardAttention attn x mask rope = let q = forwardLinear attn.qProj x
                                         k = forwardLinear attn.kProj x
                                         v = forwardLinear attn.vProj x
                                         qRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor q r; Nothing => q
                                         kRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor k r; Nothing => k
                                         scores = matMul qRope (transpose kRope)
                                         scaledScores = scaleTensor attn.scale scores
                                         maskedScores = case mask of Just m => zipWith (\rowS, mv => if head mv > 0.5 then rowS else map (const (-1.0/0.0)) rowS) scaledScores m; Nothing => scaledScores
                                         attnWeights = map softmax maskedScores
                                         context = matMul attnWeights v
                                         output = forwardLinear attn.outProj context
                                     in output

public export
record FeedForward (dim : Nat) (hiddenDim : Nat) where
  constructor MkFeedForward
  w1 : Linear dim hiddenDim
  w2 : Linear hiddenDim dim
  w3 : Linear dim hiddenDim

public export
forwardFeedForward : {dim, hDim, b, seq : Nat} -> FeedForward dim hDim -> Tensor b seq dim -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardFeedForward ff x = let gate = map (map silu) (forwardLinear ff.w1 x)
                              up = forwardLinear ff.w3 x
                              temp = zipWith (zipWith (*)) gate up
                              out = forwardLinear ff.w2 temp
                          in out

public export
record MOEFeedForward (dim : Nat) (hiddenDim : Nat) (numExperts : Nat) (numActivated : Nat) where
  constructor MkMOEFeedForward
  gate : Linear dim numExperts
  experts : Vect numExperts (FeedForward dim hiddenDim)

public export
insertBy : (a -> a -> Bool) -> a -> Vect n a -> Vect (S n) a
insertBy p x [] = [x]
insertBy p x (y :: ys) = if p x y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertBy p x ys

public export
sortPairs : Vect n (Fin n, Double) -> Vect n (Fin n, Double)
sortPairs [] = []
sortPairs (x :: xs) = insertBy (\p1, p2 => snd p1 > snd p2) x (sortPairs xs)

public export
selectTopK : {n : Nat} -> (k : Nat) -> Vect n Double -> Vect k (Fin n)
selectTopK k xs = take k (map fst (sortPairs (zip (allFins n) xs)))

public export
forwardMOE : {dim, hDim, nExp, nAct, b, seq : Nat} -> MOEFeedForward dim hDim nExp nAct -> Tensor b seq dim -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardMOE moe x = let logits = forwardLinear moe.gate x
                       weights = map softmax logits
                       routeToken : Vect nExp Double -> Vect dim Double -> Vect dim Double
                       routeToken wRow tokenRow = let topIndices = selectTopK nAct wRow
                                                      expertOutputs = map (\i => head (forwardFeedForward (index i moe.experts) [[tokenRow]])) topIndices
                                                      topWeights = map (\i => index i wRow) topIndices
                                                      weighted = zipWith scaleVect topWeights expertOutputs
                                                  in foldl addVect (replicate dim 0.0) weighted
                       processedRows = zipWith routeToken weights x
                   in processedRows

public export
record TextProjection (inFeatures : Nat) (hiddenSize : Nat) where
  constructor MkTextProjection
  linear : Linear inFeatures hiddenSize

public export
forwardTextProjection : {inF, hS, b, seq : Nat} -> TextProjection inF hS -> Tensor b seq inF -> Tensor b seq hS
forwardTextProjection tp x = forwardLinear tp.linear x

public export
record HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock
  adaLNModulation : Linear dim (dim * 6)
  norm1 : LayerNorm dim
  attn1 : Attention dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim
  norm3 : LayerNorm dim
  ff : Either (FeedForward dim (dim * 4)) (MOEFeedForward dim (dim * 4) numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seq : Nat} -> HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seq dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq 1) -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock block imageTokens masks textTokens adalnInput rope = let mods = forwardLinear block.adaLNModulation adalnInput
                                                                                                     modsVec = head mods
                                                                                                     shiftMsa = take dim modsVec
                                                                                                     scaleMsa = take dim (drop dim modsVec)
                                                                                                     gateMsa = take dim (drop (dim * 2) modsVec)
                                                                                                     shiftMlp = take dim (drop (dim * 3) modsVec)
                                                                                                     scaleMlp = take dim (drop (dim * 4) modsVec)
                                                                                                     gateMlp = take dim (drop (dim * 5) modsVec)
                                                                                                     normImg = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1 imageTokens
                                                                                                     modNormImg = map (\row => addVect (mulVect scaleMsa row) shiftMsa) normImg
                                                                                                     attnOut = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormImg masks rope
                                                                                                     gatedAttn = zipWith (\row, attnRow => addVect row (mulVect gateMsa attnRow)) imageTokens attnOut
                                                                                                     normImg2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3 gatedAttn
                                                                                                     modNormImg2 = map (\row => addVect (mulVect scaleMlp row) shiftMlp) normImg2
                                                                                                     ffOut = case block.ff of Left ff => forwardFeedForward ff modNormImg2; Right moe => forwardMOE moe modNormImg2
                                                                                                     gatedFf = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlp ffR)) gatedAttn ffOut
                                                                                                 in gatedFf

public export
record HiDreamImageTransformerBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageTransformerBlock
  adaLNModulation : Linear dim (dim * 12)
  norm1I : LayerNorm dim
  norm1T : LayerNorm dim
  attn1 : Attention dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim
  norm3I : LayerNorm dim
  ffI : Either (FeedForward dim (dim * 4)) (MOEFeedForward dim (dim * 4) numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)
  norm3T : LayerNorm dim
  ffT : FeedForward dim (dim * 4)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seqI, seqT : Nat} -> HiDreamImageTransformerBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seqI dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seqI 1) -> Tensor b seqT dim -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b (seqI + seqT) dim) -> (Tensor b seqI dim, Tensor b seqT dim)
forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock block imageTokens masks textTokens adalnInput rope = let mods = forwardLinear block.adaLNModulation adalnInput
                                                                                              modsVec = head mods
                                                                                              shiftMsaI = take dim modsVec
                                                                                              scaleMsaI = take dim (drop dim modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMsaI = take dim (drop (dim * 2) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMlpI = take dim (drop (dim * 3) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMlpI = take dim (drop (dim * 4) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMlpI = take dim (drop (dim * 5) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMsaT = take dim (drop (dim * 6) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMsaT = take dim (drop (dim * 7) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMsaT = take dim (drop (dim * 8) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMlpT = take dim (drop (dim * 9) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMlpT = take dim (drop (dim * 10) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMlpT = take dim (drop (dim * 11) modsVec)
                                                                                              normI = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1I imageTokens
                                                                                              modNormI = map (\row => addVect (mulVect scaleMsaI row) shiftMsaI) normI
                                                                                              normT = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1T textTokens
                                                                                              modNormT = map (\row => addVect (mulVect scaleMsaT row) shiftMsaT) normT
                                                                                              ropeI = case rope of Just r => Just (map (take seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing
                                                                                              ropeT = case rope of Just r => Just (map (drop seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing
                                                                                              attnOutI = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormI masks ropeI
                                                                                              attnOutT = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormT Nothing ropeT
                                                                                              gatedI = zipWith (\row, aR => addVect row (mulVect gateMsaI aR)) imageTokens attnOutI
                                                                                              gatedT = zipWith (\row, aR => addVect row (mulVect gateMsaT aR)) textTokens attnOutT
                                                                                              normI2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3I gatedI
                                                                                              modNormI2 = map (\row => addVect (mulVect scaleMlpI row) shiftMlpI) normI2
                                                                                              ffOutI = case block.ffI of Left ff => forwardFeedForward ff modNormI2; Right moe => forwardMOE moe modNormI2
                                                                                              resI = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlpI ffR)) gatedI ffOutI
                                                                                              normT2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3T gatedT
                                                                                              modNormT2 = map (\row => addVect (mulVect scaleMlpT row) shiftMlpT) normT2
                                                                                              ffOutT = forwardFeedForward block.ffT modNormT2
                                                                                              resT = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlpT ffR)) gatedT ffOutT
                                                                                          in (resI, resT)

record HiDreamImageBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageBlock
  isSingle : Bool
  singleBlock : Maybe (HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)
  doubleBlock : Maybe (HiDreamImageTransformerBlock dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seqI, seqT : Nat} -> HiDreamImageBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seqI dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seqI 1) -> Tensor b seqT dim -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b (seqI + seqT) dim) -> (Tensor b seqI dim, Tensor b seqT dim)
forwardHiDreamImageBlock block img mask txt ada rope = if block.isSingle
                                                           then case block.singleBlock of Just sb => let outI = forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock sb img mask txt ada (case rope of Just r => Just (map (take seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing) in (outI, txt); Nothing => (img, txt)
                                                           else case block.doubleBlock of Just db => forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock db img mask txt ada rope; Nothing => (img, txt)

record HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel (cfg : Config) where

  xEmbedder : Linear (cfg.patchSize * cfg.patchSize * cfg.inChannels) (cfg.numAttentionHeads * cfg.attentionHeadDim)
  peEmbedder : Linear 3 (cfg.attentionHeadDim * cfg.numAttentionHeads)
  doubleStreamBlocks : Vect cfg.numLayers (HiDreamImageBlock (cfg.numAttentionHeads * cfg.attentionHeadDim) cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts)
  singleStreamBlocks : Vect cfg.numSingleLayers (HiDreamImageBlock (cfg.numAttentionHeads * cfg.attentionHeadDim) cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts)
  finalLayer : Linear (cfg.numAttentionHeads * cfg.attentionHeadDim) (cfg.patchSize * cfg.patchSize * cfg.outChannels)

public export
concat : Vect n a -> Vect m a -> Vect (n + m) a
concat [] ys = ys
concat (x :: xs) ys = x :: concat xs ys

public export
forwardHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel : {cfg : Config} -> HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel cfg -> Tensor 1 128 Double -> Maybe (Tensor 1 1 Double) -> Vect 2 (Tensor 1 256 Double) -> Tensor 1 2048 Double -> Maybe (Vect 1 (Pair Nat Nat)) -> Tensor 1 3 3 -> Bool -> (Tensor 1 128 (cfg.patchSize * cfg.patchSize * cfg.outChannels), Maybe (Tensor 1 1 Double))
forwardHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel model hiddenStates timesteps encoderHiddenStates pooledEmbeds imgSizes imgIds isTraining = let dim = cfg.numAttentionHeads * cfg.attentionHeadDim
                                                                                                                                       tEmb = forwardLinear model.tEmbedder [[1.0]]
                                                                                                                                       pEmb = forwardLinear model.pEmbedder pooledEmbeds
                                                                                                                                       adaln = addTensor tEmb pEmb
                                                                                                                                       xEmb = forwardLinear model.xEmbedder hiddenStates
                                                                                                                                       ropeEmb = forwardLinear model.peEmbedder imgIds
                                                                                                                                       txtProj = map (\tp => forwardTextProjection tp (head encoderHiddenStates)) model.captionProjection
                                                                                                                                       txtState = head txtProj
                                                                                                                                       imgState = xEmb
                                                                                                                                       processDouble : {iSeq, tSeq : Nat} -> Tensor 1 iSeq dim -> Tensor 1 tSeq dim -> Vect l (HiDreamImageBlock dim cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts) -> (Tensor 1 iSeq dim, Tensor 1 tSeq dim)
                                                                                                                                       processDouble i t [] = (i, t)
                                                                                                                                       processDouble i t (block :: rest) = let (ni, nt) = forwardHiDreamImageBlock block i Nothing t adaln Nothing in processDouble ni nt rest
                                                                                                                                       (afterDouble, txtAfterDouble) = processDouble imgState txtState model.doubleStreamBlocks
                                                                                                                                       combined = map (\(ir, tr) => concat ir tr) (zip afterDouble txtAfterDouble)
                                                                                                                                       processSingle : {cSeq : Nat} -> Tensor 1 cSeq dim -> Vect l (HiDreamImageBlock dim cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts) -> Tensor 1 cSeq dim
                                                                                                                                       processSingle s [] = s
                                                                                                                                       processSingle s (block :: rest) = let ns = fst (forwardHiDreamImageBlock block s Nothing [[replicate dim 0.0]] adaln Nothing) in processSingle ns rest
                                                                                                                                       finalHidden = processSingle combined model.singleStreamBlocks
                                                                                                                                       outputFlat = forwardLinear model.finalLayer finalHidden
                                                                                                                                   in (outputFlat, Nothing)

                                         biasMat = replicate b bias
                                     in zipWith addVect prod biasMat

public export
forwardLayerNorm : {d, b : Nat} -> LayerNorm d -> Tensor b d -> Tensor b d
forwardLayerNorm ln x = let dNat = castNatDouble d
                            mean = map (\row => sum row / dNat) x
                            diff = zipWith (\row, m => map (\v => v - m) row) x mean
                            variance = map (\row => sum (map (\v => v * v) row) / dNat) diff
                            invStd = map (\v => 1.0 / sqrt (v + ln.eps)) variance
                            norm = zipWith (\row, s => scaleVect s row) diff invStd

                                         k = forwardLinear attn.kProj x
                                         v = forwardLinear attn.vProj x
                                         qRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor q r; Nothing => q
                                         kRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor k r; Nothing => k
                                         scores = matMul qRope (transpose kRope)
                                         scaledScores = scaleTensor attn.scale scores
                                         maskedScores = case mask of Just m => zipWith (\rowS, mv => if head mv > 0.5 then rowS else map (const (-1.0/0.0)) rowS) scaledScores m; Nothing => scaledScores

                                         context = matMul attnWeights v
                                         output = forwardLinear attn.outProj context

## Rövid Válasz

**Ez egy szimulált, nem funkcionális mock implementáció.** A kód Idris-szerű szintaxist használ és formális bizonyításoknak *látszó* lemmákat tartalmaz, de kritikus problémák miatt nem fordulna le valódi Idris fordítóval, és nem nyújt valódi formális garanciákat.[1][2][3]

## A Kód Szerkezete és Intended Purpose

### Neural Network Transformer Implementáció

A kód egy HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel implementációját célozza meg Idris függvényesen típusos nyelvben. A modell főbb komponensei:[2][4]

- **Alapvető tensor műveletek**: `matMul`, `transpose`, `addTensor` függvények length-indexed vektorokkal (`Vect n m Double`)
- **Neural network rétegek**: Linear, LayerNorm, Attention, FeedForward, MOEFeedForward
- **Transformer blokkök**: Single és double stream transformer blokkok AdaLN modulációval
- **Teljes modell**: Forward pass implementáció pooled embeddings és rope encoding támogatással

### Típusbiztonság Idrisben

Idris egy dependently typed nyelv, ahol a típusok függhetnek értékektől. A `Vect n a` típus például egy olyan vektort jelöl, amely pontosan `n` darab `a` típusú elemet tartalmaz, és ez a hosszinformáció a típus szintjén garantált.[3][4][5][6]

## Kritikus Problémák a "Bizonyításokkal"

### 1. Refl Visszaélés és Definitional Equality

Az Idrisben a `Refl` konstruktor csak akkor érvényes bizonyítás, ha mindkét oldal **definícionálisan egyenlő** - vagyis ugyanarra az értékre normalizálódnak. A kódban szereplő lemma például:[7][3]

```idris
matMulRowsLemma : (m, n, p : Nat) -> (a : Tensor m n) -> (b : Tensor n p) 
                -> length (matMul a b) = m
matMulRowsLemma m n p a b = Refl
```

Ez a lemma azt állítja, hogy `length (matMul a b) = m`, és ezt egyszerűen `Refl`-fel "bizonyítja".[6][7]

**Probléma**: A `matMul` definíciója:
```idris
matMul a b = map (\row => map (\col => dot row col) (transpose b)) a
```

Mivel `map` megtartja a vektor hosszát, a `matMul a b` hossza valóban `length a` lesz. AZONBAN a típusaláírásban `a : Tensor m n`, ami azt jelenti `a : Vect m (Vect n Double)`. A `length a` típusa `Nat`, NEM típusszintű `m`.[5][6]

### 2. NonEmpty Proof Paraméterek Ignorálása

Számos lemma `NonEmpty` bizonyítást kér paraméterként, de egyáltalán nem használja:[1]

```idris
matMulColsLemma : (m, n, p : Nat) -> (a : Tensor m n) -> (b : Tensor n p) 
                -> (0 _ : NonEmpty (matMul a b)) 
                -> length (head (matMul a b)) = p
matMulColsLemma m n p a b ne = Refl
```

A `(0 _ : NonEmpty ...)` jelölés Idris 2-ben quantity annotációt jelent, ahol a 0 azt jelenti, hogy runtime-ban törölhető. De a lényeg: **ez a proof egyáltalán nincs felhasználva a bizonyításban**.[8][9][1]

### 3. Típus- és Runtime Értékek Összekeverése

A legfontosabb probléma: a kód összekeveri a **típusszintű** és **runtime** értékeket:[4][3]

- `Tensor m n` típusban az `m` és `n` típusszintű természetes számok
- `length xs` egy runtime számítás, amely `Nat` típusú értéket ad vissza
- Ezek NEM azonosak, még ha értékük megegyezik is[4][6]

Idrisben a `Vect` hossza automatikusan garantált a típus szintjén:

```idris
-- Ez VALÓS Idris kódból származik:
lengthCorrect : (xs : Vect len elem) -> length xs = len
lengthCorrect [] = Refl
lengthCorrect (_ :: xs) = rewrite lengthCorrect xs in Refl
```

Figyeljük meg, hogy itt **induktív bizonyítás** szükséges `rewrite`-tal, nem egyszerű `Refl` ![6][7]
